title: nixos/syncthing: escape properly ignorePatterns
watch_selection_basis: PR diff (`gh pr diff 555801`) touches only the shell-command construction inside the folder-ignore-patterns curl invocation in a `let` binding (switches from an unescaped `builtins.toJSON`-interpolated `-d '...'` to a `lib.escapeShellArg`-wrapped form, fixing apostrophe-breaks-shell-quoting), plus adds a test case in nixos/tests/syncthing/folders.nix with an ignorePatterns entry containing an apostrophe. No mkOption/mkEnableOption/mkRenamedOptionModule/etc. declaration line (including for `ignorePatterns` itself) is textually touched -- this is a pure config-generation script fix, not an option-surface change. Only the baseline `enable` option was watched.
